iterations.edit_summary: Parallelized Q21 finalize with OpenMP + replaced per-order heap-allocated hash sets with stack-allocated arrays and linear scan (optimal for TPC-H's 1-7 lineitems/order).

Hoisted orders_pk_index[ok], o_orderdate[orow], o_custkey[orow], and s_nationkey[sk-1] lookups to compute once per row and reuse across all 8 branches. Added __restrict__ qualifiers on all column pointers to enable compiler CSE/vectorization. Deferred loading of rarely-needed columns (tax, returnflag, linestatus, quantity) to inside their specific branches.

Parallelized Q16 partsupp scan with OpenMP (64 threads). Replaced unordered_set<int> target_sizes and excluded_types with O(1) lookup arrays. Replaced per-group unordered_set<int32_t> for distinct suppkeys with bitsets (100K bits = 12.5KB each) merged via bitwise OR across threads. Pre-classified parts to avoid repeated dictionary lookups.

Replaced all hash-based data structures in Q16 partsupp scan with flat array lookups. Pre-classify 2M parts into group_ids via array[partkey]. Hot loop reduced to: array lookup + branch + vector push_back. Count distinct suppkeys via sort-based approach instead of per-group hash sets.
Replaced Q13 thread-local arrays with shared array + atomic increments, eliminating 384MB allocation and 96M-entry merge. Parallelized Q15 supplier revenue merge.
